blocking_failures: behavior_in_task_description: The verifier test `test_hidden_shards_generalization` requires normalizing microsecond timestamps to milliseconds (timestamp <= 10^13) and filtering out records with flags 0x01 and 0x04. These requirements are neither described in instruction.md nor checked by check_release_metrics.sh.

deterministic_tests: test_check_release_metrics_passes runs check_release_metrics.sh, which measures wall-clock time using `date +%s%N` to enforce an execution time limit (< 1.80s). This depends on wall-clock execution time, which can fluctuate under system load.

valid_failure_modes: A capable agent could fulfill all requirements in instruction.md and pass check_release_metrics.sh with 100% parity, yet fail test_hidden_shards_generalization because of the unstated requirement to normalize timestamps (> 10^13).
advice: oracle_investigates: solution/solve.sh hardcodes the timestamp threshold 10000000000000 and the division by 1000 without inspecting the shard records or database data to discover the timestamp format discrepancy, relying on knowledge known only from the test implementation.
